title: Play the lights
intro: Every model of the props below becomes a key on the visitors' phones, like a keyboard. One visitor plays at a time, for a turn; the others wait in line. A tapped key flashes its model, a held key keeps it lit, then it fades back to the show.

fields.label: Props to play, one a line: icon name | models or groups, separated by commas
fields.hint: Each model is one key (up to 48). Make a prop from a group (all the snowflakes) and each snowflake is its own key.

fields.label: Order of the keys
options: Left to right, as in the layout

fields.label: How a key lights its model

fields.text: Keys start with different colours, like a rainbow keyboard (visitors can also pick one colour)

fields.label: The turn passes on after (seconds) without a tap
Release: fade out after letting go (seconds)
